incident_spec.summary: Concurrent UPDATE statements on a single row in a small table cause significant delays due to locking contention.
symptoms: UPDATE statements take several minutes to complete despite the small table size.
Lock contention observed with ExclusiveLock and RowExclusiveLock modes.
incident_spec.mechanism: Lock contention due to concurrent updates on the same row in a table without indexes.
